desc:
The original Pachelbel Rant in full resolution! I found the transcode file from the original mini DV tape!

Thank you to everyone who liked, shared, translated, and commented on the Rant over the years. It’s been so exciting to hear about how people have found the video—some through music class in school, some found it through friends, some found it by googling Pachelbel to find Canon in D (Ha! Ta
